buyer: fleet/logistics maintenance director or equivalent work-order owner
workflow: one synthetic inspection or fault event with event_id, vehicle_id, fault_code, severity, reported_at, and optional note
event_id plus normalized event bytes establish the idempotency identity
exactly one work order and exactly one escalation for an accepted source event
crash after prepare or after effect persistence can resume without duplicating either effect
one durable closeout receipt records COMMITTED or ROLLED_BACK state
deliver a field contract, replay fixtures, exception taxonomy, run receipt, and written fit verdict for one approved workflow
acceptance: event_id, vehicle_id, fault_code, severity, and reported_at are required; severity is LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, or CRITICAL; reported_at must parse as a timestamp
replaying identical normalized event bytes after commit is a no-op that returns the existing receipt
reusing an event_id with different normalized bytes returns an explicit conflict and preserves the original event
crash and resume must converge to one work order, one escalation, one committed receipt, and zero duplicate effects
an incomplete synthetic event may roll back provisional effects and leaves a ROLLED_BACK receipt with zero effects remaining
a committed work order refuses rollback and requires operator closeout rather than silent erasure
the diagnostic uses synthetic or redacted inputs only and requires no vehicle credentials or private fleet data
the diagnostic does not dispatch technicians, connect to a production fleet, approve spend, or pay an invoice

commercial.refund: If the accepted diagnostic is not delivered inside the one-business-day window, the paid diagnostic amount is refunded unless the buyer elects in writing to receive one free next-business-day repair instead.

data_boundary: synthetic or redacted inspection/fault fixtures only; no vehicle credentials, private production fleet connection, or required private fleet data
decision_boundary: exactly-once work-order diagnostic only; never technician dispatch, production-fleet mutation, spend approval, or invoice payment
